name: midi-to-xml-monorepo
description: Workspace for MIDI, MusicXML, and Audiotool conversion tools.

scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @midi-to-xml/audiotool-to-midi && npm run build --workspace @midi-to-xml/midi-to-musicxml && npm run build --workspace @midi-to-xml/api && npm run start --workspace @midi-to-xml/api
scripts.start:api: npm run build --workspace @midi-to-xml/audiotool-to-midi && npm run build --workspace @midi-to-xml/midi-to-musicxml && npm run build --workspace @midi-to-xml/api && npm run start --workspace @midi-to-xml/api
